senses.gloss:
स्पर्ध् (or स्पृध्; cf. √ स्पृह्) cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. ii, 2) स्प॑र्धते (mc. also P. ˚ति; Subj. [प्र॑] -स्पूर्ध॑न्, RV. vi, 67, 9; pf. पस्पृधे॑, ˚धान॑, अ॑पस्पृधेथाम्, RV.; पस्पर्ध, MBh. &c.; aor. अस्पृध्रन्, स्पृधान्द्, RV. : अस्पर्धिष्ट Gr.; fut. स्पर्धिता, स्पर्धिष्यते, ib.; inf. स्प॑र्धितुम्, AV.; Br.; स्पूर्ध॑से, RV.; ind.p. -स्पृ॑ध्य, ib.),
to emulate, compete, rival, vie or cope with (instr. with and without सह, or acc.), contend or struggle for (loc.), RV. &c. &c.:
Caus. स्पर्धयति Gr.:
Desid. पिस्पर्धिषते, ib. :
Intens. पास्पर्ध्यते, पास्पर्द्धि, ib. (अपास्पाः, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 14, Sch.)
स्पृ॑ध् f. contest, competition, battle, fight, RV.
a rival, adversary, ib.
स्पृ॑ध् m. a rival, enemy, BhP.
स्पृ॑ध् mfn. emulous, vying with (comp.), ib.
स्पृ॑ध् m. desirous of ib.
स्पृध् See √ स्पर्ध्, col. 2.
स्पृधान॑. See root.
स्पृध्य. See मिथ-स्पृ˚.
2. स्पृ incorrect for √ स्पॄ.
स्पॄ (v.l. for √ शॄ) cl. 9. P. स्पृणाति, to hurt, kill, Dhātup. xxxi, 18.
स्पृ॑त् mfn. (only ifc.) delivering one's self from, removing, avoiding (see किल्बिष-स्पृत्)
gaining, winning (see धन- and लोक-स्पृत्)
स्पृ॑त् f. a kind of brick, ŚBr.
स्पृत mfn. saved, gained, won, PañcavBr.
स्पृ॑ति f. = स्पर, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
स्पृक्का f. Trigonella Corniculata, Suśr.; VarBṛS.
2. स्पृश् mfn. (generally ifc.; nom. स्पृक्) touching, coming into contact with (see क्षिति-, शव-स्पृश् &c.)
reaching to (see गगन-, भूस्पृश् &c.)
experiencing, betraying, Kāv.
स्पृश् f. = स्पृक्का, VarBṛS., Sch.
स्पृश mfn. touching, reaching to (in सर्वद्वार-स्प्˚), MBh.
स्पृश m. touch, contact (in दुः-स्प्˚, q.v.)
स्पृशा f. a kind of plant (= भुजंग-घातिनी), L.
स्पृशी f. the prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini, L.
स्पृशि mfn. = विषय-स्पृश्, Hariv. 7433 (Nīlak.)
स्पृश्य mfn. to be touched or felt, tangible, sensible, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
to be taken in possession or appropriated, Rājat.
स्पृश्या f. N. of one of the Samidhs (q.v.), KātyŚr., Sch.
स्पृष्ट mfn. touched, felt with the hand handled, AV. &c. &c.
affected or afflicted or possessed by (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
defiled (cf. comp.)

(in gram.) formed by complete contact of the organs of utterance (applied to all consonants except semivowels [called ईषत्-स्पृष्ट, ‘formed by slight contact’] and except sibilants and ह्, which are called अर्ध-स्पृष्ट, ‘formed by half-contact’), Prāt.; Śikṣ.
स्पृष्ट—ता f. formation by contact (see prec.), VPrāt.
स्पृष्ट—पूर्व mfn. felt or experienced before, MBh.
स्पृष्ट—मात्र mfn. merely touched, MW.
स्पृष्ट—मैथुन mfn. defiled by sexual intercourse, Mn. viii, 205.
स्पृष्टक n. a kind of embrace, L.
स्पृष्टिका f. touching parts of the body (as the feet &c., an asseveration or taking an oath), Mṛcch.; Mcar.
स्पृष्टिका f. See under स्पृष्टक above.
स्पृष्टव्य w.r. for स्प्रष्टव्य, Hit.
स्पृष्टा-स्पृष्टि ind. mutual touching, touching one another, L. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 2, 27).
स्पृ॑ष्टि f. touch, touching, contact, ŚBr.
स्पृष्टिन् mfn. (only ifc.) one who has touched, Gaut.
स्पृह् [cf. Gk. σπέρχω; Germ. springen; Eng. spring.]
2. स्पृह् See पुरु-स्पृ॑ह् and नि स्पृ॑ह्.
स्पृहण n. (ifc.) longing for, coveting, striving after, MBh.
स्पृहणीय mfn. to be wished or longed for, desirable, attractive to (gen. or instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
enviable, to be envied by (gen.), R.; Kathās.
स्पृहणीय—ता f.
स्पृहणीय—त्व n. desirableness, enviableness, Kāv.; Rājat.
स्पृहणीय—शोभ mfn. having desirable or enviable beauty, MW.
स्पृहय॑द्-वर्ण mfn. striving after or eager for any partic. appearance or form, vying in appearance or lustre, RV.
स्पृहया॑य्य mfn. to be striven after or contended for, desirable, RV.
desiring, desirous (= स्पृहयालु), Uṇ. iii, 96, Sch.
स्पृहया॑य्य m. = नक्षत्र, ib.
स्पृहयालु mfn. eagerly, desirous, eager, jealous, envious, longing for or to (dat. loc., or inf.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
स्पृहयालु—ता f. (ifc.) desire of, longing for, Śāntiś.
स्पृहयितृ mfn. one who envies, an envier of (gen.), Nir., Sch.

स्पृहा f. (ifc. f(आ). ) eager desire, desire, covetousness, envy, longing for, pleasure or delight in (dat., gen. loc., or comp.; acc. with √ कृ or बन्ध्, ‘to long for, be desirous of [loc. or comp.]’; with √ कृ, ‘to envy any one [loc.]’), MBh.; R. &c.
a kind of plant (v.l. स्पृशा), L.
स्पृहा—वत् mfn. desirous of, longing for, delighting in (loc.), Ragh.; MārkP.
स्पृहालु mfn. = स्पृहयालु, L.
स्पृहित mfn. desired, wished for, longed for, MW.
स्पृह्य mfn. to be wished for or desired, W.
स्पृह्य m. the citron tree, L.
